data.title: Utility statement 2024/25 – €184.20 balance due
data.summary: Muster Apartments GmbH sent the heating and hot water statement for 1 October 2024 to 30 September 2025, dated 3 November 2025. Actual costs were €1,624.20 against €1,440.00 in advance payments, leaving €184.20 to pay within 30 days of the statement date.
data.explanation: Your advance payments for heating and hot water were lower than the actual costs, so you owe an additional €184.20 (Nachzahlung). The letter asks you to pay within 30 days of the statement date, so pay by the deadline shown, using the bank details on the letter and quoting your tenant number. It is worth checking the figures against your consumption and any breakdown that came with the letter, which was not included in this text. If something looks wrong, contact the sender's billing team. The letter gives no formal objection procedure. Seek advice from a tenants' association if you are unsure.
